1214.description:
秋雨前線や低気圧の影響で、10日も広い範囲で大気の状態が不安定になっていて、伊豆諸島では局地的に雨雲が発達して「レベル4土砂災害危険警報」が発表されている地域があり、厳重な警戒が必要です。

このほか…

1213.title: Women's tennis has a new world number one as US Open showdown looms
1213.description: Elena Rybakina becomes world number one for the first time by reaching the US Open semifinals, despite defending champion and current top-ranked player Aryna Sabalenka still being alive in the tournament.

1212.title: Sick of the city, Queenslanders head west and boost property prices
1212.description: They lived in some of the Queensland's most sought-after areas, so what was the appeal of heading west for a country town?

1211.title: Dockers goalsneak Dudley reflects on improbable AFL rise
1211.description: As his Fremantle Dockers look to bounce back against Geelong in an AFL semifinal on Friday night, Isaiah Dudley hopes his improbable story encourages other footballers to overcome their setbacks and never give up on their dreams.

1210.title: Opals survive in last second after surrendering 20-point lead at World Cup
1210.description: A short-handed Australian team is still alive and into the quarterfinals at the FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup despite surrendering a 20-point three-quarter-time lead against Italy.

1209.title: Live: Expert doubts constitutionality of Commonwealth grant scheme
1209.description: A constitutional law expert says the Commonwealth should not be paying for sporting club upgrades because it is not a federal responsibility. Follow live.

1208.title: Trump gave $45,000 cash gifts to Natalie Harp and two other aides, public records show
1208.description: The White House has described the cash gifts to Harp and three others as personal - and legal.

1207.title: アメリカ 共和党大会始まる 中間選挙前に初開催
1207.description: アメリカのトランプ政権に対する有権者の評価が示される11月の中間選挙を前に、与党・共和党の、中間選挙前では初めての党大会が始まりました。トランプ大統領は初日に演説する予定ですが、支持率が下落傾向にある…

1206.title: AFA hopes Benin and Burkina Faso can tempt Messi to one last dance in Argentina
1206.description: Lionel Messi has retired from international football – but Argentina’s football authorities still have a couple more games in mind… Leer más

1205.title: Dog survives croc attack at Darwin beach, public urged to stay vigilant
1205.description: Top End residents are urged to stay vigilant near waterways after a three-year-old Cavalier King Charles Spaniel was attacked in shallow water at a Darwin beach.

1204.title: Iran and US strike tankers in biggest shipping attack since war began
1204.description: Iran and the US on Wednesday traded their biggest wave of attacks on shipping since the war began, with Iran saying it struck 10 vessels near the Strait of Hormuz after US forces sank five Iranian oil tankers. Brent crude oil surged above $100 a barrel as fears grew over global energy supplies.

1203.title: Aid cuts force clinic closures across Sudan
1203.description: In tonight's edition, funding cuts are forcing dozens of health clinics in Sudan to close, aid groups warn. Also, an AI and Africa conference has kicked off in South Korea's capital. And we have a poke around the Rwanda Space Agency as Paris hosts its very first international space summit.

1202.title: Man charged over court data breach asked AI for legal advice, court hears
1202.description: A Sydney man charged over a massive data breach involving a NSW courts website allegedly used generative AI to create "scraper" computer code for bulk downloading before asking ChatGPT for legal advice, a court hears.

1201.title: Iran referred to UN Security Council for nuclear non-compliance
1201.description: Tehran condemns the resolution, blaming US and Israeli strikes on its nuclear facilities for disrupting inspections.

1200.title: Greyhound trainer handed lifetime ban for 'egregious' actions
1200.description: SA greyhound trainer Jack Clayton Trengove has been found "entirely unfit" to participate in the industry, with the state's governing body issuing him with a lifetime disqualification and a $5,000 fine.

1199.title: Anger as lead found at 10 Broken Hill childcare centres
1199.description: The NSW Environment Protection Agency faces criticism after finding high lead contamination at 10 of Broken Hill's 13 childcare facilities.

1198.title: 国連本部で日本寄贈の「平和の鐘」鳴らす式典
1198.description: 世界的な停戦と平和を訴える国際平和デーを前に、ニューヨークの国連本部で日本から贈られた「平和の鐘」が鳴らされ、グテーレス事務総長は各国の指導者に平和の構築に向けた行動を呼びかけました。
